description: Labeled cases for evaluating the Scope Creep Defender classifier. expectedOutOfScope is the ground-truth label (true = the new client request is additional, out-of-scope work that is NOT covered by the contract). Cases span web, mobile, design, content, and consulting contracts, with a mix of clearly in-scope, clearly out-of-scope, and borderline requests.

cases.contract:
1. PROJECT SCOPE

The Contractor will design and develop a five (5) page marketing website: Home, About, Services, Blog, and Contact.

2. REVISIONS

Two (2) rounds of revisions are included per page. Additional revisions are billed at $75/hour.

3. PAYMENT

Total fee $4,000, billed 50% upfront and 50% on delivery.
cases.request: Can you also build an online store with a shopping cart and checkout while you're at it?

cases.contract:
1. PROJECT SCOPE

The Contractor will design and develop a five (5) page marketing website.

2. REVISIONS

Two (2) rounds of revisions are included per page.
cases.request: Could you change the headline color on the homepage? This is our first revision request.

SCOPE

Contractor will build exactly five (5) pages: Home, About, Services, Blog, Contact.
cases.request: We'd like to add a Careers page and a Case Studies page too.

cases.contract:
SCOPE

Contractor will build five (5) pages including a Contact page with a working contact form.
cases.request: Can you make sure the Contact page form sends to our sales@ inbox?

cases.contract:
SCOPE

A static marketing website with hard-coded content provided by the Client.
cases.request: Actually we want to be able to edit all the text ourselves — can you add a full CMS?

cases.contract:
SCOPE

Contractor will develop and deploy the website to the Client's hosting account.
cases.request: Once it's ready, please deploy it to our hosting so it goes live.

cases.contract:
SCOPE

Website design and development only. SEO and marketing are explicitly excluded.
cases.request: Can you also do the SEO so we rank on Google?

cases.contract:
WARRANTY

The Contractor will fix any bugs reported within thirty (30) days of launch at no additional cost.
cases.request: The contact form stopped sending emails — we launched 12 days ago. Can you fix it?

cases.contract:
WARRANTY

The Contractor will fix any bugs reported within thirty (30) days of launch at no additional cost. After 30 days, support is billed hourly.
cases.request: It's been three months since launch and we found a small bug. You'll fix it free right?

cases.contract:
SCOPE

Five-page website. No third-party integrations included.
cases.request: Can you integrate Stripe payments and a Mailchimp signup form?

cases.contract:
SCOPE

The website will be fully responsive across desktop, tablet, and mobile.
cases.request: Please make sure it looks good on iPhone — the menu seems off on mobile.

cases.contract:
SCOPE

Designer will deliver one (1) primary logo in PNG and SVG formats.

OWNERSHIP

Full ownership transfers to the Client upon final payment.
cases.request: We also need a full brand style guide, social media kit, and business card designs.

cases.contract:
SCOPE

Designer will deliver one (1) primary logo in PNG and SVG formats, plus a black-and-white variant.
cases.request: Can you send over the black-and-white version of the logo as well?

cases.contract:
REVISIONS

A maximum of two (2) revision rounds are included. Further rounds are $90 each.
cases.request: This is our fourth set of changes — just tweak the colors again, should be quick.

cases.contract:
REVISIONS

A maximum of two (2) revision rounds are included.
cases.request: First round of feedback: can the icon be a bit bolder?

cases.contract:
USAGE

Designs are licensed for digital use only. Print usage is not included.
cases.request: We're going to print 500 posters of this design for an event — that's fine, right?

cases.contract:

Upon final payment, Designer will provide the editable source files (AI, PSD).

SCOPE

Brand identity design: logo, color palette, typography.
cases.request: Could you also design and build our website using this branding?

cases.contract:
SCOPE

cases.request: Can you share the hex codes for the brand color palette?

cases.contract:

Writer will produce four (4) blog articles of up to 1,000 words each per month.

cases.request: This month can you also write 10 LinkedIn posts and a press release?

DELIVERABLES

Four (4) blog articles per month, including one round of edits each.
cases.request: Please make the requested edits to the second blog article.

cases.request: Can we schedule the 60-minute call to go over the report?

cases.contract:
SCOPE

cases.request: We've used our 10 hours but need 8 more hours of your time this month.

cases.contract:
SCOPE

Monthly retainer includes unlimited email support and up to ten (10) call hours.

A single competitive analysis report.
cases.request: On top of the report, can you also build us a financial model in Excel?

cases.contract:
SCOPE

Includes the audit report and one (1) follow-up revision based on Client feedback.
cases.request: We have feedback on the audit — can you do the one included revision?

TIMELINE

Any work requested outside the agreed timeline is subject to a 25% rush surcharge.

50% deposit due on signing, 50% on delivery.
